InterswitchSPAK National Science Competition Details

InterswitchSPAK National Science Competition is an annual search across high schools (public and private) in Nigeria for only SS 2 (year 11) students between the ages of 14-17 years.

It is introduced to chart the ideal career path and drive the student towards full optimization of their potentials and fulfilment of their dreams (either as an inventor or entrepreneur) with a key message of revving up the interest of students; parents, teachers and other key stakeholders towards STEM  education and its application in Africa.

The competition consists of two main levels: 

  • Stage One: Written Qualifying Examination This stage is divided into two parts:

    Round One Examination: All registered candidates must take the National Qualifying Exam at the specified time and date set by the organizers. Round Two Examination: Students who score 75% and above across all states will move on to the next stage. From this pool, the top 81 students will qualify for Stage Two (TV Quiz Show).

  • Stage Two: TV Quiz Competition

    The top 81 students from the written examination will advance to this stage. The competition will be recorded and broadcast on television across Nigeria and Africa.InterswitchSPAK National Science Competition Benefits

InterswitchSPAK National Science Competition Requirements

To be eligible for the InterswitchSPAK National Science Competition, applicants must satisfy the following conditions:

  • You must be a student in Year 11, attending a full time Secondary education in any High school (Public and Private) in Nigeria

  • You must be between the age of 15 to 18 residing in Nigeria

  • You must be willing to travel out of your State

  • Sound knowledge of Physics, Chemistry, Biology & Mathematics based on the current Year 11 NECO syllabus is important

  • You must be willing to comply with the rules laid down by the Producers.
